data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Tomas, meaning 'twin'. In the Bible, the name Thomas is borne by one of the twelve apostles. The name Tommie carries the meaning “Twin” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tommie usually hope their child will grow to embody twin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Tommie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Twin.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tommie total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: The name Tommie is more commonly found in the English speaking world, particularly in the United States. Tommie is often thought of as a nickname for the name Thomas, which is a classic and traditional name with deep historical and cultural roots in the Christian faith. Tommie may also evoke images of athletic abilities, as there have been notable individuals with this name in various sports, including professional American football and basketball.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Tommie holds spiritual significance through its biblical origins. In the New Testament, Thomas is one of the twelve apostles, often referred to as "Doubting Thomas," who demanded physical proof of Jesus' resurrection before he could believe. Despite his doubtful nature, Thomas ultimately became a devout follower of Jesus, and his name serves as a reminder of the importance of faith, even in the face of doubt and uncertainty.
